bar.piecesHint: How many separate pieces it comes out as
bar.startAgainBody: Every setting goes back to how it started. Undo will still bring this back.
colours.bothNamed: {characters} is named by both extra colours. The second one wins; take it out of one of them.
colours.charactersHint: Type the characters this colour should go on. "7" colours every 7; "a,b" colours the a and the b.
colours.everythingHint: The whole keyring, printed in one filament.
colours.lettersHint: Every letter not given a colour of its own below.
colours.notInText: {characters} isn't in the text, so that colour won't show.
colours.note: The colours go into the 3MF as its material list, with each piece assigned a filament — so a slicer opens it with the letters and the border already told apart.
colours.oneNote: One colour throughout: the pieces still come out named and separate, so you can change filament by hand if you want to.
error.badAlign: Pick how the lines line up.
error.badSmoothRadius: The smoothing radius has to be more than nothing.
error.borderNotSolid: The border didn't come out as a solid. Try a wider border or a taller one.
error.missingGlyphs: This font has no {glyphs}. Try another font.
error.negativeLineGap: The space between lines can't be negative.
error.noRoomForMagnet: There's no room for a magnet. Make the keyring bigger.
error.noText: Type something to put on the keyring.
error.nonPositive: Heights and widths have to be more than nothing, and gaps can't be negative.
error.notClosed: That didn't come out as a closed solid. Change a setting and try again.
error.notNumbers: Every setting has to be a number.
error.ringHitsLetters: That ring runs into the letters. Move it.
error.ringTooBig: A ring's hole has to be smaller than nine tenths of the ring.
error.strokesTooThin: The strokes are too thin and the letters vanish. Thicken them.
error.tooNarrow: Make it at least {min} mm across.
error.wontFitWidth: That won't fit the width you set. Narrow the gaps, the border or the ring, or make it wider.
file.3mfNote: Colours and the filament for each piece. Best for a slicer.
file.notesNote: Filaments, pieces and the order to do them in.
file.stlNote: One mesh, for anything that reads nothing else.
letters.addFontNote: A TTF or OTF from your own computer. It stays in this window and isn't uploaded anywhere.
letters.gapHint: Measured between the real outlines, not the font's own spacing.
letters.keepWidthHint: On: the letters shrink to keep the width you set. Off: the letters keep their size and the width follows.
letters.strokeHint: 0 leaves the letters as the font draws them. Raise it for a thin font so the letters survive printing; lower it to slim them.
magnets.baseNote: With these magnets the base has to be at least {min} mm; it is {actual} mm.
magnets.dragNote: Drag a magnet on the picture to move it. One that overlaps another, or hangs off the edge, is nudged back.
magnets.embeddedNote: Add the pause in your slicer, just before the layer that closes the pocket. Nothing is written into the file.
magnets.extraAcrossHint: Added to the magnet's width so it goes in. Start at 0.2 mm and test one.
magnets.hint: Round pockets in the back for shop-bought magnets, so the keyring sticks to a fridge or a toolboard.
magnets.howItGoesInHint: From the back: the pocket is open underneath, so the magnet pushes or glues in afterwards. Mid-print: the pocket is closed over, so you pause the print and drop the magnet in.
magnets.note: Up to six round magnets, 8 mm across at most.
magnets.openNote: At least 0.6 mm of material is left above each pocket.
magnets.ribsHint: Four small bumps in the pocket wall that hold a magnet pushed in from the back, without glue.
magnets.title: Magnets
notes.apartOnly: Shell and letters apart. The letters are {clearance} mm smaller all round, so they press into the shell.
notes.bothWays: Both versions are in the file: the joined keyring, and the shell with loose letters ({clearance} mm press-fit).
notes.build: Base {base} mm · border stands up {border} mm · letters stand up {letters} mm
notes.inPieces: Careful: the shape is still in more than one piece. Widen the border, raise the fill, or add a bridge.
notes.magnetEmbedded: Pockets are closed over: pause the print just before the layer that covers them and drop the magnets in.
notes.magnetOpen: Pockets are open at the back: push or glue the magnets in once it's printed.
notes.name: {text} keyring
notes.noSupports: No supports needed: every face sits on the plate or is bridged by the layer below.
notes.onePiece: One piece. Assign the filament above to each part, or print it in one colour and paint the letters.
output.both: Both: the file holds the joined keyring and the loose letters, side by side.
output.clearanceHint: Taken off each side of every letter so it drops into its recess. 0.2 mm suits most printers.
output.hint: A keyring can come as one piece to print in two colours, or as a shell and letters to print apart and press together.
output.pickOne: Pick at least one, or there's nothing to make.
output.separate: The letters separately, to press in
output.title: What comes out
rings.dragNote: Drag a ring on the picture to move it. One pushed outside the shape is slid back to where it still holds.
rings.hint: The holes the keyring hangs from. Each sits inside a thicker collar so it doesn't tear out.
rings.none: No ring, so this is a plaque rather than a keyring.
rings.reinforceHint: Adds material between the collar and the nearest letter, so the ring can't snap off.
rings.title: Key rings
save.name: Its name
save.title: Save to Thingport
shape.baseHint: The flat plate everything sits on. With magnets it can't go thinner than the deepest one needs.
shape.borderWidthHint: How far the border reaches out past the letters.
shape.bridgeHint: Where the shape would fall into pieces, a bar this wide joins them.
shape.edgesHint: Easing the top and bottom edges, so the keyring doesn't feel sharp. 0 leaves an edge square.
shape.fillVoidsHint: Closes any hole in the border that isn't a letter's own counter or a key ring.
shape.heldBack: ({asked} asked, held back by a narrow part)
shape.infillHint: 0 follows the letters exactly. Raise it to fill the hollows between them, so the outline gets simpler and stronger.
state.gettingReady: Getting the font and the modeller
toast.fontTooBig: That font file is bigger than 8 MB.
toast.notAFont: That isn't a font this can read: {error}
toast.stillWorking: It's still working that out — try again in a moment.
view.canvas: The keyring, drag to turn it, scroll to zoom
view.placeMagnet: Drag a magnet where you want it
view.placeRing: Drag a ring where you want it
view.which: Which way to look at it
